description: Send a +1 or -1 signal about the receiver of a completed transfer you sent: it moves the receiver's reputation score in the TEG by one (the score getTegReputationRankings ranks by, never below 0), once per transaction. It does not enter the EigenTrust trust graph (getTrustScore). Agent JWT; only the transfer's sender may signal.
name: theprotocol_applyReputationSignal
title: Apply Reputation Signal
